in_sanskrit.name: Hiyanshi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of knowledge and wisdom
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hiyanshi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Hiyanshi is derived from Sanskrit roots ‘hi’ meaning sun and ‘yanshi’ meaning knowledge. This name represents the goddess of knowledge and wisdom. It is believed that a child named Hiyanshi will be blessed with the power of knowledge and the ability to acquire wisdom. In Hindu mythology, this name is also associated with the goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, music, and art.
